name: swarm-core
description: swarm-core: the pure C++23 ports every swarm-routing protocol core builds on (IClock, IRng, INeighborProvider, ITimerScheduler, ILinkState, ILinkQuality, ILinkMetric, IEnergy, IEnergyProvider, IRouterObserver, and the experimental ILocationProvider), shared primitives (pheromone table, selection, dedup history, visited path), the little-endian wire helpers, the 4-byte wire envelope, and the testbench with its header-only protocol contract tests; no OS or simulator headers.
